correctness.rationale: The exact cycle resolvent, reflection split into nonpositive odd-sector and rank-two nonnegative even-sector perturbations, strictly monotone 2x2 secular equations, and the threshold (L-2)/2 prove exactly two eigenvalues >2 for L>=5. A standalone standard-library Jacobi and eigenvector verifier passes 131 finite assertions. No finite data are used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The integer edge-budget contrast 0/1/2 chords has a natural physical meaning: adding one remote identical shortcut turns an otherwise bounded Perron-mode relaxation time into an exponential tunneling time although only two among O(L) edges differ. The exact cubic decay and prefactor and rigorous GRW comparison make this a reusable benchmark for rare structural defects, beyond a routine substitution.
